title: Technology Sector Update for 10/10/2018: BT,AAPL,IMPV,CLS,CLS.TO,NVDA
text:

Technology stocks were being routed on Wednesday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing more than 2.7% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling nearly 2.7%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) BT Group plc ( BT ) rose as much as 6% on Wednesday following reports the UK-based networking equipment company was talking with Apple ( AAPL ) about a potential partnership that would ease its entry into the pay-television market.
In other sector news:
(+) Imperva ( IMPV ) rose as much as 29% on Wednesday after the cybersecurity firm agreed to be bought by technology-focused investment company Thoma Bravo for $2.1 billion and also reporting better-than-expected preliminary Q3 financial results.
(+) Celestica ( CLS ) climbed 2.6% on Wednesday after the Canadian contract electronics manufacturer announced the $329 million acquisition of Impakt Holdings.
(-) Nvidia ( NVDA ) dropped nearly 6% at one point Wednesday. The chipmaker said Swedish automaker Volvo has selected the Nvidia Drive AGX Xavier computer for its next-generation vehicles.
